about: Races for the dashboard's Races view. Coach-maintained. kind race: one per event (status: registered (entered), planned (committed, registration pending), considering (a specific event that fits around registered and planned races), exploring (a placeholder for a race type and timing, not committed), done). kind race_note: the race plan by section. kind race_kit: the packing list (ticks are saved in the dashboard store under race_kit/<race id>). After a race set status done and add result. registration: what is known about entry, in words (status, rules, prices, sources). reg_dates (Nov 5, 2026): every dated registration event as 'YYYY-MM-DD|what|basis;...', basis posted (the organizer shows it) or expected (the previous edition's pattern); openings say 'opens', closings say 'closes'; required for planned, considering and exploring races, optional deadlines for registered ones; coach/tools/race_check.py turns it into the check-in's registration lines. reg_checked: date the official pages were last checked. with: who joins (';'-separated). approx: date follows last year's edition. stats: result tiles 'value|label;...'. Weather (added Oct 18 at the athlete's request): wx_kind forecast (NWS point forecast, refreshed by the morning run from 7 days out) or typical (approx. climate normals for the date, Estimated); wx_hi and wx_lo in °F; wx_text conditions; wx_plan what it means for kit, pacing and fueling; wx_src and wx_at source and date; wx_days for forecast races: 'YYYY-MM-DD|hi|lo|text;...' shown beside the until-race-day list; water: expected water temperature where swimming or paddling. Structure (Nov 2, 2026): every race fills coach/race_template.json by stage (lat/lon = start area for the NWS forecast); python3 coach/tools/race_check.py lists the gaps. Shared Race Season page (Nov 3, 2026): coach/tools/build_season.py writes coach/dashboard/season.html from these rows, public fields only (public_name or name, date, approx, sport, status, distance, location, with, stats, url, weather without wx_plan); public_name is an optional shorter name for that page. Roadmap (Nov 3, 2026): the dashboard's Season Roadmap lists every registered, planned and done race from here, plus any race with roadmap: true (the Spring 50K); plan.json milestone rows hold only non-race items (tests, weight target, ultra check).
